module LockIou where

import Iou (GetCash(..), Amount)

template LockableIou
  with
    payer: Party
    owner: Party
    amount: Amount
  where
    signatory payer
    observer owner

    choice Assign : ContractId LockedIou
      with
        beneficiary: Party
      controller owner
        do
          create LockedIou with payer; owner; beneficiary; amount

    choice Call : ContractId GetCash
      controller owner
        do
          create GetCash with payer; owner; amount

template LockedIou
  with
    payer: Party
    owner: Party
    beneficiary: Party
    amount: Amount
  where
    signatory payer
    observer beneficiary, owner

    choice Transfer : ContractId LockableIou
      controller owner
        do
          create LockableIou with payer; owner = beneficiary; amount

-- architecture-handbook-entry-begin: IouDaml
module Iou where

import Daml.Script

data Amount = Amount {value: Decimal; currency: Text} deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

amountAsText (amount : Amount) : Text = show amount.value <> amount.currency

template Iou
  with
    payer: Party
    owner: Party
    amount: Amount
    viewers: [Party]
  where

    ensure (amount.value >= 0.0)

    signatory payer
    observer owner
    observer viewers

    choice Call : ContractId GetCash
      controller owner
      do
        create GetCash with payer; owner; amount

    choice Transfer : ContractId Iou
      with
        newOwner: Party
      controller owner
      do
        create this with owner = newOwner; viewers = []

    choice Share : ContractId Iou
      with
        viewer : Party
      controller owner
        do
          create this with viewers = (viewer :: viewers)
-- architecture-handbook-entry-end: IouDaml

template GetCash
  with
    payer: Party
    owner: Party
    amount: Amount
  where
    signatory payer, owner

template Dummy
  with
    party: Party
  where
    signatory party

issue owner payer =
  script do
    payer <- allocateParty payer
    owner <- allocateParty owner
    submit payer do
        createCmd $ Iou with payer = payer; owner = owner; amount = Amount {value = 100.0; currency = "USD"}; viewers = []

bankIssuesIouToAlice = issue "Alice" "Bank"

davidsBankIssuesIouToDavid = issue "David" "DavidsBank"

transfer owner newOwner payer =
  script do
    payer <- allocateParty payer
    owner <- allocateParty owner
    newOwner <- allocateParty newOwner
    iouId <- submit payer do
        createCmd $ Iou with payer = payer; owner = owner; amount = Amount {value = 100.0; currency = "USD"}; viewers = []
    submit owner do
        exerciseCmd iouId Transfer with newOwner = newOwner

aliceTransfersIouToBob = transfer "Alice" "Bob" "Bank"

transferAndCall owner newOwner payer =
  script do
    payer <- allocateParty payer
    owner <- allocateParty owner
    newOwner <- allocateParty newOwner
    iouId <- submit payer do
        createCmd $ Iou with payer = payer; owner = owner; amount = Amount {value = 100.0; currency = "USD"}; viewers = []
    newIouId <- submit owner do
        exerciseCmd iouId Transfer with newOwner = newOwner
    submit newOwner do
        exerciseCmd newIouId Call

aliceTransfersAndBobCallsIou = transferAndCall "Alice" "Bob" "Bank"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: community/common/src/main/daml/CantonExamples/SafePaint.daml
@@
+module SafePaint where
+
+import Daml.Script
+import Iou
+import LockIou
+
+usd : Amount
+usd = Amount with value = 125.50; currency = \"USD\"
+
+testIouIssueAndCall = script do
+  bank <- allocateParty \"Bank\"
+  alice <- allocateParty \"Alice\"
+  stranger <- allocateParty \"Stranger\"
+  submitMustFail bank do
+    createCmd "'$ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = Amount with value = -0.01; currency = "USD"; viewers = []
+  iou <- submit bank do
+    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = Amount with value = 0.0; currency = "EUR"; viewers = []
+  submitMustFail stranger do exerciseCmd iou Call
+  submitMustFail bank do exerciseCmd iou Call
+  cash <- submit alice do exerciseCmd iou Call
+  cashData <- queryContractId alice cash
+  case cashData of
+    None -> assert False
+    Some data_ -> do
+      assert (data_.payer == bank)
+      assert (data_.owner == alice)
+      assert (data_.amount == Amount with value = 0.0; currency = "EUR")
+  assert (queryContractId alice iou == None)
+  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd iou Call
+
+testIouTransferAndShare = script do
+  bank <- allocateParty "Bank"
+  alice <- allocateParty "Alice"
+  bob <- allocateParty "Bob"
+  carol <- allocateParty "Carol"
+  dave <- allocateParty "Dave"
+  iou <- submit bank do
+    createCmd $ Iou with payer = bank; owner = alice; amount = usd; viewers = [carol]
+  assert (queryContractId carol iou /= None)
+  assert (queryContractId dave iou == None)
+  submitMustFail bob do exerciseCmd iou Share with viewer = dave
+  shared <- submit alice do exerciseCmd iou Share with viewer = dave
+  assert (queryContractId alice iou == None)
+  sharedData <- queryContractId dave shared
+  case sharedData of
+    None -> assert False
+    Some data_ -> do
+      assert (data_.payer == bank)
+      assert (data_.owner == alice)

testLockedIouDirectAndRepeatedAssignment = script do
  bank <- allocateParty \"Bank\"
  alice <- allocateParty \"Alice\"
  bob <- allocateParty \"Bob\"
  carol <- allocateParty \"Carol\"
  locked <- submit bank do
    createCmd "'$ Lock.LockedIou with payer = bank; owner = alice; beneficiary = bob; amount = usd
  submitMustFail carol do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  lockable <- submit alice do exerciseCmd locked Lock.Transfer
  lockableData <- queryContractId bob lockable
  case lockableData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail alice do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = carol
  lockedAgain <- submit bob do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = carol
  lockedAgainData <- queryContractId carol lockedAgain
  case lockedAgainData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.beneficiary == carol)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail carol do exerciseCmd lockedAgain Lock.Transfer
  finalIou <- submit bob do exerciseCmd lockedAgain Lock.Transfer
  finalData <- queryContractId carol finalIou
  case finalData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == carol)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)

testAmountAsText = script do
  assert (amountAsText usd == show usd.value <> "USD")
  assert (amountAsText (Amount with value = 0.0; currency = "EUR") == show (0.0 : Decimal) <> "EUR")
EOF

  lockedAgain <- submit bob do exerciseCmd lockable Lock.Assign with beneficiary = carol

    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == bob)
      assert (data_.beneficiary == carol)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
  submitMustFail carol do exerciseCmd lockedAgain Lock.Transfer
  finalIou <- submit bob do exerciseCmd lockedAgain Lock.Transfer
  finalData <- queryContractId carol finalIou
  case finalData of
    None -> assert False
    Some data_ -> do
      assert (data_.payer == bank)
      assert (data_.owner == carol)
      assert (data_.amount == usd)
